title: Associate, Transaction Services Account Management (TSAM)
full_description:
Product Relationship Management
Xinying District, Taiwan
ING Bank covers Wholesale and Retail Banking in Asia Pacific. Our Wholesale Banking business is present and active in 11 major economies in the Asia Pacific, namely China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Indonesia, Japan, Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam.
Step into a role where execution meets impact
At ING, Transaction Services plays a critical role in helping clients move, manage, and grow their businesses across borders. As ING continues to expand its Transaction Services footprint in Asia, this role offers the opportunity to be close to complex deals, meaningful collaboration, and real business impact — without losing sight of operational excellence.
If you bring a strong foundation in operations or credit and are ready to apply that expertise closer to the commercial side of the business, this role could be your next step.
As an Associate in Transaction Services Account Management, you will support the growth and development of ING’s Transaction Services business in Taiwan. You will focus on ensuring smooth execution of locally booked transactions, strong risk and compliance standards, and effective coordination across local and regional stakeholders.
This is an individual contributor role that combines transaction oversight, risk awareness, and business support in an international Wholesale Banking environment.
You will join theTransaction Services team in Taiwan, part of ING Wholesale Banking. The team works closely with Sales, Product, Risk, Operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver trade finance and cash management solutions to corporate clients.
The role reports to theHead of Transaction Services, Taiwan, and offers exposure to both local execution and regional coordination. Client interaction is part of the role, typically alongside or through senior team members.
Transaction oversight:Monitor and support the execution of locally booked Transaction Services deals, ensuring timely escalation of issues and securing approvals for any deviations
Risk & compliance:Perform transaction monitoring, due diligence, and periodic reviews in line with the bank’s risk appetite and internal policies
Business development support:Assist in identifying and assessing new Transaction Services opportunities, contributing insights to enhance client solutions and profitability
Operational excellence:Ensure smooth end‑to‑end processes and timely resolution of operational matters, supporting efficiency and client satisfaction
Atertiary degreein a relevant field
3-6 years’ experiencein Transaction Services, with strong exposure to trade products and receivables financing or Trade Operations experience within banking
A thorough understanding ofcredit riskfor Wholesale and Trade Finance transactions, including the ability to analyse financial statements and product risk
Hands‑on experience withtrade finance and cash management solutions
Strong transaction management skills and the ability to work effectively across geographies and functions
Clear, confident communication skills, withstrong written and verbal English and Mandarin
A self‑directed, motivated mindset, with resilience, learning agility, and a collaborative approach
Exposure to akey growth businesswithin ING Wholesale Banking
An international environment with close collaboration across Asia
Opportunities to apply operational or credit expertise in a broader commercial context
A culture that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning
Click the apply button on our career site and submit your application viaWorkday, ING’s official recruitment system.
Job Application Safety Reminder⚠️
We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:
Apply only via official ING platforms: ING usesWorkdayas its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site.
Check the sender’s email carefully: legitimate communication will always come from@ing.comand/or@myworkday.com
No payments or banking details will ever be requested. If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.
